# os.cron

Manage a cron job via /etc/cron.d/<name>

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `command` | string | No | - |
| `day` | string | No | - |
| `env` | object | No | - |
| `hour` | string | No | - |
| `minute` | string | No | - |
| `month` | string | No | - |
| `name` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `schedule` | string | No | - |
| `state` | string | No | - (allowed: `present, absent`) |
| `user` | string | No | - |
| `weekday` | string | No | - |
